issue.title: Cut a sase-core release containing 23f19f0 and raise the sase-core-rs floor before the next sase release
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-zu.8.5 (epic sase-zu.8, acceptance) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes #5 and #6; filed by sase-zu.8.land on 2026-09-13.

The published dependency floor lags the pinned cohort: pyproject.toml allows sase-core-rs>=0.34.23, but schema-30 index / scan-wire-9 support exists only at pin 23f19f0 (current sase-core-revision.txt pin 7f43a996 is its direct child), which no release tag contains — the newest release commit is v0.34.24 (782dc74), which predates 23f19f0.

`just check`'s core-floor probe reports blocked_unpublished: published 0.34.23 lacks artifact_ref_link_location_wire_schema_version and artifact_ref_split_link_location (from 17947a0) plus continuation_decide_resume_adoption and continuation_plan_retention (from 23f19f0). This is non-blocking for local/dev gates (probe exits 0) because dev installs build sase-core from the pinned checkout.

Remediation: cut a sase-core release containing 23f19f0 (or later), wait for the sase-core-rs wheel to publish, then raise the pyproject.toml floor through tools/ratchet_core_window. A sase release MUST NOT ship before this lands, otherwise a PyPI install pairs sase with a binding missing the sase-zu.8 machine-parity and index-completeness fixes.

task_type_fields.impact: A PyPI install pairs sase with a binding missing schema-30 index / scan-wire-9 support, so published-wheel users lack the sase-zu.8 machine-parity and index-completeness fixes; dev/CI installs building from the pin are unaffected (probe exits 0).
task_type_fields.location: pyproject.toml sase-core-rs constraint; sase-core commits 17947a0 and 23f19f0; tools/ratchet_core_window
task_type_fields.repro: Run just check's core-floor probe on master ef254fd6dc: it reports blocked_unpublished — published sase-core-rs 0.34.23 lacks artifact_ref_link_location_wire_schema_version/artifact_ref_split_link_location (17947a0) and continuation_decide_resume_adoption/continuation_plan_retention (23f19f0); git tag --contains shows no release tag contains either commit.

payload.entry: RELATED (link write blocked: hidden plans clone holds another agent's untracked links/202609/prose_if_proc_directive_false_positive.md.json): sase-wg — same floor-bump task shape for an earlier gate (imported_source_owner, v0.32.20). sase-xn — same dependency-floor pattern, distinct missing binding (tail_text_by_lines_and_chars). sase-km — the core-floor blind spot: probes check binding names, not wire schema versions. sase-10a — its fleet route tests fail at sase-core 17947a0, which the awaited release contains.

evidence.note: Independent impact during sase-zw landing at main 8f7dad695b: workspace wheel allowed by the old floor returns scan wire 8/index 27 and lacks continuation_plan_retention; current retention planning raises AttributeError, four artifact-retention tests fail, three tiering tests reject wire 8, and var integration sees 27 vs30. Current pin is 7f43a996; core source contains the bindings, so fresh dev install is required locally. The published dependency-floor gap is the existing task, not a new disk defect.
